AI-GRD.1.title: Guardrail Enforcement — Required Safety Filters Active

factor_a.label: guardrails_required
factor_a.description: Minimum number of active safety guardrails required (e.g., content filter, PII redaction, toxicity detector).
factor_a.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 9(2)(a); NIST AI RMF MANAGE 4.1

factor_b.label: guardrails_active
factor_b.description: Number of safety guardrails confirmed active at inference time.
factor_b.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 9(2)(a); NIST AI RMF MANAGE 4.1

evaluation.description: Verifies that the required safety guardrails were active when the inference executed. A FAIL indicates the model ran without mandatory safety controls.

AI-GRD.2.title: Content Safety Filter — Output Classification Passed

factor_a.label: content_safety_required
factor_a.description: Whether content safety filtering must pass (1 = required).
factor_a.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 9(4)(b); NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.5

factor_b.label: content_safety_passed
factor_b.description: Whether the inference output passed content safety classification (1 = clean, 0 = refusal or content filter triggered).
factor_b.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 9(4)(b); NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.5

evaluation.description: Confirms the model output did not trigger content safety filters (refusal, toxicity, or policy violation). A FAIL creates an immediate alert for human review.

factor_a.label: provenance_required
factor_a.description: Whether prompt/response hash capture is required (1 = yes). Proves the inference occurred and was recorded.
factor_a.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 12(1); NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5

factor_b.label: provenance_captured
factor_b.description: Whether the prompt and response were hashed and anchored (1 = captured, 0 = missed).
factor_b.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 12(1); NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5

evaluation.description: Confirms that every AI inference was cryptographically fingerprinted at the point of execution. The prompt and response hashes prove the interaction occurred without retaining the raw content.

AI-INF.2.title: Inference Latency — Response Time Within Threshold

factor_a.label: latency_threshold_ms
factor_a.description: Maximum acceptable inference latency in milliseconds (e.g., 30000 = 30 seconds). Exceeding this threshold indicates model degradation or resource exhaustion.
factor_a.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 15(3); NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.6

factor_b.label: measured_latency_ms
factor_b.description: Actual round-trip latency of the inference in milliseconds, measured from request initiation to response completion.
factor_b.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 15(3); NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.6

evaluation.description: Verifies that the AI model responded within the operational time boundary. Latency spikes may indicate model poisoning, resource contention, or unauthorized model substitution.

AI-MDL.1.title: Model Weight Integrity — Deployed Hash Matches Approved

factor_a.label: model_integrity_required
factor_a.description: Whether model identity verification is required (1 = yes). Ensures the deployed model matches the approved version.
factor_a.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 9(4)(a); NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.1

factor_b.label: model_identity_verified
factor_b.description: Whether the model ID returned by the provider matches the requested model (1 = match, 0 = mismatch or unavailable).
factor_b.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 9(4)(a); NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.1

evaluation.description: Confirms the AI provider served the exact model version that was requested. Detects unauthorized model swaps, shadow deployments, or provider-side version changes.

AI-MDL.2.title: Model Version Tracking — Version Identifier Recorded

factor_a.label: version_tracking_required
factor_a.description: Whether the model version identifier must be recorded (1 = yes).
factor_a.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 12(2)(b); NIST AI RMF MANAGE 2.2

factor_b.label: version_recorded
factor_b.description: Whether the model version or system fingerprint was captured in the witness record (1 = recorded, 0 = missing).
factor_b.regulatory_ref: EU AI Act Art. 12(2)(b); NIST AI RMF MANAGE 2.2

evaluation.description: Ensures model version lineage is maintained across all inferences. Required for EU AI Act Article 12 traceability and NIST AI RMF GOVERN function.
